subject.title: Add Atomic Chat as a bundled local provider (OpenAI-compatible, 127.0.0.1:1337)

question: Should Atomic Chat be promoted into OpenClaw's bundled provider surface, or should it remain an external/custom OpenAI-compatible provider path?
rationale: Current main can already talk to OpenAI-compatible local servers through custom provider config, while bundling Atomic Chat changes supported provider/auth/onboarding surface and requires maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Decide Through Linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89618 to choose bundled-provider sponsorship or external routing.

options.title: Sponsor Bundled Provider
options.body: Approve the product direction and require the linked PR to repair dependency, labeler, docs, and compatibility blockers before merge.

options.title: Keep Atomic Chat External
options.body: Route Atomic Chat to a maintained external provider/plugin or docs-only custom-provider recipe, then close this issue and the implementation PR with that decision.

recommendation.title: Decide Through Linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89618 to choose bundled-provider sponsorship or external routing.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is product/onboarding scope rather than a narrow code defect, and recent history shows steipete working on AI setup/onboarding surfaces.
